release.notes: - New "SolidCAM Automation" tab in SOLIDWORKS with the Machine Simulation Builder button. It opens a resizable window (VMID toolbar, Geometry / Machine axes / Export panes, Output Log, Check for updates). The task pane tab is gone. - Add axis is now on the right-click menu of Machine base. - New Install.exe and Uninstall.exe: double-click and allow the change; they work where scripts are blocked and write install.log. - install.cmd asks for administrator rights itself and handles folders with brackets. - Assignments, preview, ModuleWorks, external STL, VMID reload and selection sync work as before.
